SystemCodeDisplay (en)DefinitionJSONXML
http://smart.who.int/ips-pilgrimage/CodeSystem/IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT  CONSENT-KSAConsent for Kingdom of Saudi ArabiaThe Pilgrim consents to share his-her International Patient Summary (IPS data) during the provision of clinical care at Ministry of Health-Saudi Arabia in Haj District area healthcare facilities through the Hajj-1446/2025 event as any follow up care that might be needed from any healthcare practitioners
http://smart.who.int/ips-pilgrimage/CodeSystem/IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT  CONSENT-IDNConsent for Indonesia<INSERT TEXT FROM INDONESIA: discuss pilgrims's consent to utilize Satusehat to enable access to KSA to their IPS if they are in need of care during Hajj>
http://smart.who.int/ips-pilgrimage/CodeSystem/IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT  CONSENT-MYSConsent for MalaysiaThe Malaysian Hajj pilgrim has provided consent for sharing the International Patient Summary (IPS) generated from the data recorded during the Hajj pilgrim health examination, as well as the vaccination records stored on MySejahtera to Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
http://smart.who.int/ips-pilgrimage/CodeSystem/IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT  CONSENT-OMNConsent for Oman<INSERT TEXT FROM OMAN: discuss pilgrims's consent to utilize Oman's e-Health Portal to enable access to KSA to their IPS if they are in need of care>
http://smart.who.int/ips-pilgrimage/CodeSystem/IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT  CONSENT-XXKConsent for Onesa (fictional example)Fictional example, used by this guide's examples and the pilgrim's journey: the Onesan pilgrim consents to Onesa's health information exchange releasing the International Patient Summary (IPS), generated from the data recorded during the pre-pilgrimage health examination, to the Ministry of Health of Taifafeki for clinical care during the pilgrimage. Onesa (ISO 3166-1 user-assigned code XXK) is not a real country; this code is modelled on CONSENT-MYS.
http://smart.who.int/ips-pilgrimage/CodeSystem/IPS.HAJJ.CONSENT  CONSENT-XXRConsent for Taifafeki (fictional example)Fictional example, used by this guide's examples and the pilgrim's journey: the pilgrim consents to share his-her International Patient Summary (IPS) during the provision of clinical care at Ministry of Health of Taifafeki healthcare facilities through the pilgrimage, and any follow-up care that might be needed from any healthcare practitioners. Taifafeki (ISO 3166-1 user-assigned code XXR) is not a real country; this code is modelled on CONSENT-KSA.

contains.display: Consent for Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
